notes.title: Demo/Pre-release v0.10.0 is LIVE
notes.notes:
Hi Consonance Players,



v0.10.0 includes the following changes:

Options can now be accessed from the Title Page.

Tips now show in the Level Select and Levels.

Changes for Level 2-4: Cables (pre-release version only) to make it less ambiguous.



For any feedback and bug reports, please visit the Consonance Community Hub.

Thank you and have a great day.


James Filomar
(Developer)

notes.title: Demo/Pre-release v0.9.1 is LIVE - Timer Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Hi Consonance Players,



This patch is to fix a bug where the timer in the levels increments slowly in some machines.



Unfortunately, your previous games' recorded times can no longer be corrected. If you wish to reset all previous games' recorded times, you may do so by going to Options > Reset All Data 



I apologize for any inconvenience.



For any feedback and bug reports, please visit the Consonance Community Hub.

Thank you and have a great day.


James Filomar
(Developer)

notes.title: Demo v0.9.0 is LIVE - Casual Mode Update
notes.notes:
Hi Consonance Players,



Hope you are enjoying the Demo. I'm excited to announce that Demo v0.9.0 is now LIVE.

This update contains the Casual Mode, a special mode where puzzle animations are slowed down for a more relaxed experience.


Changelog:
Casual Mode - a special mode where puzzle animations are slowed down

Added a "Next Level" button on completion of a level

Some levels' animations were slowed down

Minor animation changes in some levels



For any feedback and bug reports, please visit the Consonance Community Hub.

Thank you and have a great day.


James Filomar
(Developer)
